votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 5 of 2025 with Mayor Mendenhall, recognizing March as National Women's History Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall declaring March as National Women's History Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item (2025-29 HUD Consolidated Plan Update and Timeline) to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the City's next five-year HUD Consolidated Plan for 2025-29 and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item (FY 2025-26 Funding Allocations for One-year Action Plan for CDBG and Other Federal Grants) to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY 2025-26 One-Year Annual Action Plan and associated federal grant funding allocations and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 13 of 2025, vacating an L-shaped City-owned alley that begins at approximately 268 West Paxton Avenue.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance vacating an L-shaped city-owned alley near 268 West Paxton Avenue, creating an easement from 300 West for abutting property owners.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Item B-4 (FY 2024 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant application) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Police Department's grant application to the U.S. Department of Justice for travel, training, cameras, and other law enforcement purposes, and refers it to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 14 of 2025, approving a $100,000 loan for Cold Plunge Coffee, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance approving a $100,000 Economic Development Loan Fund loan to Cold Plunge Coffee, LLC at 475 East 300 South to support job creation and retention.

votes.motion: Adopt a legislative action initiating a text amendment to consolidate and simplify the R-1 single-family residential districts, including updates to residential flag lot standards, new housing options, and elimination of barriers to homeownership, with consideration of similar changes to R-2, SR-1, and SR1-A zones.
votes.description: Initiates a legislative action directing the Planning Division to draft a zoning text amendment consolidating R-1 districts and studying impacts on affordable housing, walkability, water conservation, and missing middle housing options.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Kim Shelley as the Director of Public Lands.
votes.description: Confirms the Mayor's appointment of Kim Shelley to serve as the Director of Public Lands for Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Brian Redd as the Salt Lake City Chief of Police.
votes.description: Confirms the Mayor's appointment of Brian Redd to serve as the Salt Lake City Chief of Police.

Approves the consent agenda items including setting a public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY 2024-25 and approving board appointments for James Alfandre and Eric Mcgill to the Parks, Natural Lands, Urban Forestry, and Trails Advisory Board and Richard Leverett to the Planning Commission.
